import re

from tqdm import tqdm

### main configs - do not edit
if not verbose:

    import warnings
    warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

if mode in ['rag', 'search']:

    # init data structures for search
    embedding_names = ['dim_' + str(i) for i in range(0, utils.EMBEDDING_P)]
    
    # for storing results
    # small set meant for subsequent join onto more data below
    embeddings_cache = pd.DataFrame(columns=meta_list)
    
    # cycle through types of queries
    for k1 in ann_search_dict:

        embeddings_df = ann_search_dict[k1]['embeddings']
        embedded_query = ann_search_dict[k1]['embedded_query']
        
        # check for when text or special data field is not used
        if embeddings_df is not None:

            # init distance to max value
            embeddings_df['Distance'] = np.inf

            # vectorized search to compare user query to all embedded docs
            # uses L2 norm as distance metric
            # sort to find lowest distances
            test = np.reshape(embeddings_df.loc[:, embedding_names].values, (embeddings_df.shape[0], utils.EMBEDDING_P))
            norm = np.sum(np.abs(test-embedded_query)**2,axis=-1)**(1./2)
            embeddings_df['Distance'] = norm
            embeddings_df.sort_values(by='Distance', inplace=True)
            embeddings_cache = pd.concat([embeddings_cache, embeddings_df.iloc[0:n_responses*2, [0, 1, -1]]])

    # join lowest distance docs onto text and other metadata
    embeddings_cache = embeddings_cache.join(text_data, how='left') 
    
    # remove any duplicate hits across searches
    embeddings_cache.drop_duplicates(subset=meta_list, inplace=True)
    embeddings_cache.sort_index(inplace=True)
    
    if verbose:
        print('---------- ----------')
        print('Preliminary search results:')
        print('---------- ----------\n')
